{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "CommonJS",
    "lib": [
      "ES2022",
      "DOM"
    ],
    "rootDir": "src",
    "outDir": "dist",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "moduleResolution": "node",
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "downlevelIteration": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true
  },
  "include": [
    "src/**/*"
  ],
  "exclude": [
    "node_modules",
    "dist"
  ]
}

    "glob": "^13.0.0",
